Official installation guide ↗

PhotoCraft for Windows

MSI installer / portable ZIP

Visit official downloads
Looking for a specific build? View the latest GitHub release · Refer to the release page for versions and files
  1. Choose your architecture

    Choose x64 for most Intel / AMD PCs, or arm64 for ARM devices. Match the official installer to your device architecture.

  2. Install or extract

    Run the MSI and follow the installation wizard. For the portable ZIP, extract all files before launching the app.

  3. Open your first file

    Use File → Open to open an image or a copy of a PSD. Check the layers, then save it as a new file.

Do Photoshop plugins work in PhotoCraft? →

A FEW GOOD ANSWERS

Good questions.

A few things to know before you begin.

Is PhotoCraft free?

The official project is open source under your choice of MIT or Apache-2.0. Download it through official channels and consult the repository licenses for usage and redistribution terms.

Can it fully replace Photoshop?

Not yet. The project is still in early alpha. Professional workflows, generative AI, complex document compatibility and the plugin ecosystem have gaps. Try your most common tasks using copies of your files first.

Can I open my existing PSD files?

PhotoCraft can read and write PSD / PSB files, but complex effects, text and third-party plugin content may differ. Keep your original file, save a copy, and check layers, text and the final rendering.

Is this the official PhotoCraft website?

No. This is an independent resource hub with official links and getting-started guides. We are not affiliated with ArtCraft or Adobe. Official releases are the source of truth for software, versions and feature status.
